neighbours.label: ' and' joining two prenominal modifiers that share one head noun (e.g. 'locally-owned and operated bank', 'error-detecting and correcting codes')
fire: We are a family-owned and operated bakery on Main Street.
The study compared HIV-positive and HIV-negative patients in Nairobi.
They funded a publicly owned and accountable hospital network.
The drug targets growth-promoting and angiogenic receptor kinases.
Engineers use error-detecting and correcting codes in storage.
She runs a locally sourced and hand-made candle shop.
The firm sells water-resistant and shock-proof watch cases.
These are low-cost and energy-efficient heating systems.
quiet: We are a bakery on Main Street, and we bake bread every morning.
The study compared patients in Nairobi with patients in Mombasa.
They funded a hospital network, and the public owns it outright.
The drug targets receptor kinases that promote tumour growth.
Engineers use codes in storage to detect errors early.
She runs a candle shop and sells candles at the market.
The firm sells watch cases, and they resist water quite well.
These heating systems cost little to run in the winter.

notes: Top 32: ' und' x10, ' and' x9. German 'und' not tested here.
